purpose: Accuracy as a function of weight and activation bit width, without any runtime or chip in the loop; and whether quantization-aware fine-tuning recovers low bit widths.
claim_boundary: Exploratory, planned after the main study's test results were known. Bit widths below 8 are simulated (integer grids in floating point); no deployed low-bit kernel is timed here.
calibration: the model's own artifact-free session-1 trials, normalized with its training statistics
